= Lilly Roth }} {{status | name = Feeding Frenzy | type = Buff | description = Your Minions deal more Damage and have increased Attack, Cast and Movement Speed }} '''Feeding Frenzy Support''' is a [[minion]] [[support gem]]. It changes the supported minion behaviour to be [[Minion#Aggressive and Defensive|aggressive]], allowing them to engage on enemies from farther away. Supported minions have a chance to give the owner the Feeding Frenzy [[buff]] on [[hit]], which grants a damage and speed bonus to all friendly minions. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Feeding Frenzy buff: {{c|help|Feeding Frenzy grants 10% more Minion Damage, 10% increased Minion [[Movement Speed]] and 10% increased Minion [[attack speed|Attack]], and [[Cast Speed]]}} * Minions are Aggressive: {{c|help|Aggressive minions have their targeting range increased to a minimum value}}
If a minion is both Aggressive and Defensive, the effects will cancel each other out. This can be beneficial in situations where the stats provided by {{il|Meat Shield Support}} and Feeding Frenzy Support are desired, but a change to the minion's normal aggro range isn't. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Feeding
